text_1989: The day will come when the retribution will overwhelm them, from above them and from beneath their feet.

subtitle: Immigrate in the Cause of God
text_1981: O My servants who believed, My earth is spacious, so worship Me.
text_1989: O My believing servants, My earth is spacious, so worship Me alone.
text_ref: O My servants who believed, My earth is spacious, so worship Me.

text_1981: Every soul will taste death, then to us you will be ultimately returned.
text_1989: Every soul will taste death, then to us you will be returned.
text_ref: Every soul will taste death, then to us you will be ultimately returned.

text_1981: Those who believe and lead a righteous life, we will surely settle them in Paradise, with mansions and flowing streams. Eternally they abide therein. What a beautiful reward for the workers.
text_1989: Those who believed and led a righteous life, we will surely settle them in Paradise, with mansions and flowing streams. therein. recompense for the workers.
text_ref: Those who believe and lead a righteous life, we will surely settle them in Paradise, with mansions and flowing streams. Eternally they abide therein. What a beautiful reward for the workers.

text_1981: They are the ones who steadfastly persevere, and trust in their Lord.
text_1989: They are the ones who are steadfast, and in their Lord they trust.
text_ref: They are the ones who steadfastly persevere, and trust in their Lord.

text_1981: Many a creature that does not carry its provision, GOD provides for it, as well as for you. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.
text_1989: Many a creature that does not carry its provision, GOD provides for it, and for you. He is Hearer, Knower.
text_ref: Many a creature that does not carry its provision, GOD provides for it, as well as for you. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

subtitle: Most Believers Destined for Hell
text_1981: If you ask them, "Who created the heavens and the earth, and put the sun and the moon in your service," they will say, "GOD." Why then did they deviate?
text_1989: If you asked them, “Who created the heavens and the earth, and com­ mitted the sun and the moon in your service,” they would say, “GOD.” Why then did they deviate?
text_ref: If you ask them, "Who created the heavens and the earth, and put the sun and the moon in your service," they will say, "GOD." Why then did they deviate?

text_1981: GOD is the One who increases the provision for whomever He chooses from among His creatures, and withholds it. GOD is fully aware of all things.
text_1989: GOD is the One who increases the provision for whomever He chooses from among His creatures, and withholds it. GOD is fully aware of all things.
text_ref: GOD is the One who increases the provision for whomever He chooses from among His creatures, and withholds it. GOD is fully aware of all things.

text_1981: If you ask them, "Who sends down from the sky water, to revive dead land," they will say, "GOD." Say, "Praise GOD." Most of them do not understand.
text_1989: If you asked them, “Who sends down from the sky water, to revive dead land,” they would say, “GOD.” Say, “Praise GOD.” Most of them do not understand.

subtitle: Re-arrange Your Priorities
text_1981: This worldly life is no more than vanity and play, while the abode of the Hereafter is the real life, if they only knew.
text_1989: This worldly life is no more than vanity and play, while the abode of the Hereafter is the real life, if they only knew.
text_ref: This worldly life is no more than vanity and play, while the abode of the Hereafter is the real life, if they only knew.

text_1981: When they ride on a ship, they implore GOD, devoting their prayers to Him. But as soon as He saves them to the shore, they revert to idolatry.
text_1989: When they ride on a ship, they implore GOD, devoting themselves to Him. But as soon as He saves them to the shore, they revert to idolatry.
text_ref: When they ride on a ship, they implore GOD, devoting their prayers to Him. But as soon as He saves them to the shore, they revert to idolatry.

text_1981: Let them disbelieve in what we have given them, and let them enjoy temporarily; they will surely find out.
text_1989: Let them disbelieve in what we have given them, and let them enjoy temporarily; they will surely find out.
text_ref: Let them disbelieve in what we have given them, and let them enjoy temporarily; they will surely find out.

text_1981: Have they not seen that we have established a Sacred Sanctuary that we made secure, while all around them the people are in constant danger? Would they still believe in falsehood, and reject GOD's blessings?
